scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:customer" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:printer" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:all-frontend: concurrently "npm run dev:customer" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:printer"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix apps/admin && npm run build --prefix apps/admin && npm install --prefix apps/customer && npm run build --prefix apps/customer && npm install --prefix apps/printer && npm run build --prefix apps/printer && npm install --prefix server && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('public', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('public', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('apps/admin/dist', 'public/admin', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('apps/customer/dist', 'public/customer', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('apps/printer/dist', 'public/printer', {recursive:true});"
